bm_desc: Zydus Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 31, 2026, titled "Zydus Announces Positive Topline Results from Completed EVIDENCES-X Phase II(b) Clinical Trial of Saroglitazar Mg in MASH".

Zydus Lifesciences Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Proceedings of Annual General Meeting held on August 11, 2026. Further, the company has submitted the Exchange a copy of Scrutinizers report along with voting results.
Zydus Lifesciences Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
